rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when the reference point is now.

example.english: I have hitherto avoided eating at this restaurant.
example.traditional: 到而家為止，我都未試過喺呢間餐廳食飯。
example.jyutping: dou3 ji4 gaa1 wai4 zi2 ngo5 dou1 mei6 si3 gwo3 hai2 nei1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when describing what had happened up to a particular past or future time rather than up to now.

example.english: They had hitherto failed to find the missing child.
example.traditional: 到嗰時為止，佢哋仲未搵到失蹤嘅小朋友。
example.jyutping: dou3 go2 si4 wai4 zi2 keoi5 dei6 zung6 mei6 wan2 dou3 sat1 zung1 ge3 siu2 pang4 jau5
